decider.basis: 1 Fargate ARM task 2 vCPU / 8 GB x 730 h at assumed $0.0356/vCPU-h + $0.0039/GB-h

laya.basis: runs in-process in the worker task; ~0 incremental

laya_calibrated.basis: runs in-process in the worker task; ~0 incremental

bedrock_qwen32b.basis: qwen.qwen3-32b-v1:0: ~335 in / 60 out tokens per ticket x 15150

bedrock_nova.basis: eu.amazon.nova-lite-v1:0: ~335 in / 60 out tokens per ticket x 15150

winner.rule: highest clean routing accuracy on the common clean ids (3 dp), then ECE, then USD/month; injection is not an eligibility filter. The low-confidence threshold is chosen on the calib split and applied to eval.
